method: Original 0x18ddc40 runs natively; the six callees are intercepted at entry and recorded with arguments, the gathered context array contents and provider snapshots. Python composes run_pose_pair_link_jobs with the same authored services.
comparisons: ordered callee calls with every argument
provider slot-table and +0x170..0x17f snapshots at each call
coverage: pair counts 0..0xffffffff including n/10 boundaries and 32-bit high values
mutation trials: services rewrite slot-table entries, swap the global dispatcher, scribble +0x170/+0x17c before publication and advance the cursor during dispatch
failure_proof: Gathering contexts before 18de510 instead of after fails at case 39.
Reading the global dispatcher only once fails at case 19.
limits: All callees are supplied; their behavior is reconstructed elsewhere (retire, dispatcher, pair worker) or not at all (neighbor retire is separate; rebalance and merges are not reconstructed).
Zero-worker behavior of the supplied rebalance/dispatcher is not asserted.
No live validation or concurrency guarantee.
